metadata.title: Haven-1 public-reference assembly R1
metadata.stage: CAD review only — no thermal/CFD solution
metadata.axis: X docking end 0 to window/opposite end 10.1 m; Y lateral; Z window/up
assumptions: Exterior section lengths and all internal dimensions inferred; not manufacturer CAD.
12 mm display shell is not a selected or verified wall thickness.
Representative cabin layout is not calibrated to published 80 m3 pressure/45 m3 habitable volumes. Those values are source metadata, not model-derived volumes.
Radiator panel location/count/area and all piping topology are candidate assumptions.
Equipment colors identify systems, not temperatures.
No Dragon vehicle is included. No fabricated mission temperatures, powers, stresses or mesh convergence.
